runtime/io_decorators#

The native layer under io/decorators: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under io/decorators: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Narrow mutable counters used by io/decorators. They retain no wrapped Reading/Writing objects and expose no generic mutable-cell abstraction.
